profile.headline: Senior Software Quality Assurance Engineer
profile.summary:
• Over a decade of software testing experience in cloud products, mobile apps and open-source software.  Builds frontend and API test automation, CI/CD workflows to run during various parts in the software development process.

• Experienced in Agile software development process and Jira software administration.  Adaptable to different release cadences and development frameworks (Kanban/Sprints).  Drives process modifications to balance frequent code pushes with high quality software.

• Skilled in application performance monitoring to read server health and diagnose performance issues.  Fluent in tools such as New Relic and AWS console.

positions.title: Senior Software QA Engineer
positions.description:
• Assured product quality of the Factory Talk Edge Manager product, and Edge Applications by verifying functionality, creating test plans and enumerating test cases.
• Automated front end testing using Cucumber and Selenium Webdriver with Typescript and dashboards on Azure.
• Created containerized apps and Type-1 VMs, persistent storage volumes, and cloud init scripts to run virtualized company products.  
• Built and maintained QA hardware lab for use by the company.  Set up Allen Bradley industrial PCs, controllers and networks to allow testing and troubleshooting.
• Authored product documentation for internal and public consumption.  Generated documentation in Jama for ISO-9001 regulatory compliance.
positions.insights: Skills: Python (Programming Language) · Selenium WebDriver · EVE-OS · Docker Products · TypeScript · Software Quality Assurance · Git · Python · docker · Edge Computing · Jama · Linux

positions.title: Software Engineer In Test
positions.description:
•	Established and owned the release process of DLive Protocol and go-btfs products.  Created Jenkins jobs to build executables for both products.
•	Built Continuous Integration jobs for go-btfs to assure a stable codebase.  Created Docker containers to allow running microservices locally that perform tests with dockerized Postgres and Redis.
•	Automated deployment of DLive Protocol infrastructure and configuration with the goal to allow deployment by anyone on the team including non developers.
•	Built DLive Protocol performance test framework using Github Workflows which reports latency between nodes running in different parts of the world.
•	Added analytics reporting to gain insights into user behavior and performance.
•	Mentored QA engineers on building test automation and code reviews.
positions.insights: Skills: Bug Tracking · Python (Programming Language) · Selenium WebDriver · Selenium · Continuous Integration and Continuous Delivery (CI/CD) · Test Planning · Docker Products · Software Quality Assurance · Documentation · Git · GitHub · Jenkins · Python · Test Cases · Automation · API Testing · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · QA Automation · Software Testing · Linux · DevOps

positions.title: Lead Software QA Engineer
positions.description:
* Built automated testing framework from scratch that is used to run API and front-end Selenium based tests.  The framework is being used and expanded by QA and software engineers.
* Developed CI/CD workflows using CircleCI and EBS post deployment scripts to trigger needed test automation at various steps of the development process. 
* Created Amazon Lambda functions to facilitate reporting of test results in Slack via hubot.
* Performed application monitoring for bi-weekly deployments.
positions.insights: Skills: Bug Tracking · Selenium WebDriver · Test Planning · Docker Products · Software Quality Assurance · Git · Python · Test Cases · Automation · API Testing · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · QA Automation · Software Testing · DevOps

positions.title: Senior QA Engineer
positions.description:
Senior Quality Assurance Engineer
Fitbit, Site Engineering, San Francisco
•	Instrumental in the release of the Sleep Stages micro service.  Verified feature set, monitored instance health, diagnosed end to end any issues found by users.
•	Performed release coordination for daily fitbit.com site deployments as a backup Release Coordinator.
•	Wrote API endpoints and automated tests that are run as part of CI testing.
•	Wrote Selenium tests to verify functionality of fitbit.com features.
•	Manually tested Fitbit app and firmware updates for activity trackers on Android and iOS devices.
positions.insights: Skills: Bug Tracking · Selenium WebDriver · Test Planning · Docker Products · Software Quality Assurance · Git · Python · Test Cases · Automation · API Testing · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · QA Automation · Software Testing

positions.title: Sr QA Engineer
positions.description:
•	Successfully tested the Python, PHP and dotNet application server monitoring product from initial conception to release.
•	Built test applications to verify product functionality and bug fixes using Python frameworks including Django, Flask and Pyramid.
•	Helped create and maintain internal tool to measure performance overhead and long running stability of product.
•	Built and configured various Linux environments on Amazon EC2, VSphere and Docker for use by multiple teams.
•	Created tests using Cucumber and unit test frameworks and configured Jenkins to run in an automated fashion.
•	Answered customer support tickets and reproduced customer problems as the support hero.
positions.insights: Skills: Bug Tracking · Test Planning · Docker Products · Software Quality Assurance · Git · Python · Test Cases · Automation · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · QA Automation · Software Testing

positions.title: Sr Support Engineer, Wily Introscope
positions.description:
•	Provide first level support by assisting enterprise level customers over the phone and through the support website.
•	Diagnose problems on customer’s complex environments including investigating custom web applications and front and backend systems.   
•	Facilitate communication between customer and second level sustaining team.
•	Reproduce and document bugs to assist sustaining team in finding solutions.
•	Advocate for the customer during internal triage meetings.

positions.title: QA Engineer
positions.description:
•	Designed test cases and performed functionality testing, application server compatibility testing and bug triage.
•	Configured test environments to test functionality and reproduce customer issues, including clustered application servers, multi-nested proxies and multiple data sources.
•	Supported the sales team by investigating and resolving customer deployment issues.
•	Composed end of cycle test reports for new features.
positions.insights: Skills: Bug Tracking · Software Quality Assurance · Git · Test Cases · Software Testing

positions.title: QA Engineer
positions.description:
•	Developed and established company-wide quality assurance procedures and testing processes for software releases to top financial investment firms.
•	Performed testing for financial modeling client/server application that scores stock market analysts on predicted earnings accuracy.
•	Conducted full functionality testing, browser and OS compatibility testing, and data verification on company’s three websites.
positions.insights: Skills: Software Quality Assurance · Git · Test Cases · Software Testing
